review_evidence: README describes TypeTopology as a long-running blackboard for new constructive univalent mathematics intended for publication.
The source tree contains 995 primary Agda/literate-Agda files, with dedicated indices and module descriptions for definitions, concepts, and theorems.
No source-local subtree was identified as losslessly removable maintenance material; the mathematical development is the repository purpose.
summary: Retain TypeTopology: a large Agda development of constructive univalent mathematics with nearly one thousand primary literate source files.
